breaking_news.headline: The economy slowed a bit -- but Americans continued to spend
breaking_news.summary: The U.S. economy grew at an annual rate of 1.5% in the spring, according to the Commerce Department. That's a modest slowdown from the previous quarter — but consumer spending picked up steam.

breaking_news.headline: European soccer leaders to boycott  the World Cup in an unprecedented step
breaking_news.summary: European soccer associations said they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA reverses a controversial deal to sell minority stakes to the marquee soccer tournament.

breaking_news.headline: Are you choosing to stay single? We want to hear from you
breaking_news.summary: Solo living, solo travel, and solo dining are all being embraced as more adults are choosing to remain single. Many Americans aren't interested in dating, and being single is a symbol of autonomy.

breaking_news.headline: Mortgage rates hit their highest level in a year, driven by war and inflation concerns
breaking_news.summary: The 30-year fixed-rate mortgage reached 6.66% on average Thursday.

breaking_news.headline: Oil companies report sky-high profits thanks to wartime crude prices
breaking_news.summary: Chevron reported its highest quarterly earnings ever. Shell had its second-biggest quarter, and ExxonMobil doubled its earnings compared with the same time last year.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA scraps controversial deal to sell stakes in World Cup to private investors
breaking_news.summary: FIFA abandoned a plan to create a commercial venture and then sell stakes to minority investors, just days after unveiling it. The plan drew sharp condemnation — and a boycott from European nations.

breaking_news.headline: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
breaking_news.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.

breaking_news.headline: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
breaking_news.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.

breaking_news.headline: Peru's ex-president leaves jail after 15-year jail term for corruption overturned
breaking_news.summary: Ollanta Humala had been convicted of money laundering offences alongside his wife in 2025.

breaking_news.headline: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
breaking_news.summary: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

breaking_news.headline: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
breaking_news.summary: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

breaking_news.headline: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
breaking_news.summary: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

breaking_news.headline: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
breaking_news.summary: Some 19 major Italian cities - including Rome, Milan and Naples - are already on red alert, and by Monday all but two will be.

breaking_news.headline: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
breaking_news.summary: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

breaking_news.headline: Call for 'full review' as pressure grows on Infantino
breaking_news.summary: The leadership of Fifa is publicly questioned by football's governing bodies in Europe, North and Central America and the Caribbean.

breaking_news.headline: Spain attacks 'selfish' response of some EU countries to Ceuta migrant crossings
breaking_news.summary: Italy has temporarily suspended the Schengen arrangement with Spain as Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni called scenes in Ceuta "shocking".

breaking_news.headline: UK petrol prices hit highest level since Iran war began
breaking_news.summary: The price of unleaded hits 160p a litre, according to motoring group the RAC, as oil prices remain elevated.

breaking_news.headline: India wants to join the strawberry superpowers
breaking_news.summary: Indian strawberry farmers rely on varieties imported from the US and Europe, but that could change.

breaking_news.headline: Stick to spending limits, PM and chancellor tell ministers in joint memo
breaking_news.summary: The Chancellor said the Budget on 28 October would “meet our fiscal rules” and give families "stability" to plan for the future.

breaking_news.headline: Sainsbury's agrees to sell Argos for £120m
breaking_news.summary: Under the terms of the deal, Argos will still operate in Sainsbury's shops, sell Habitat products, and offer Nectar points.
